name: Lift
description: Brings up the quiet end: tails, breaths and the air between notes rise towards a line, and what is loud stays exactly as it is.

params.name: Threshold
params.description: The line the quiet end is lifted towards. Sound louder than this is left alone; raise it and more of each tail and pause comes up.

params.name: Amount
params.description: How far quiet sound is carried up to the threshold. A little keeps the shape of a fade; fully up holds a tail level until it lets go.

params.name: Floor
params.description: Under this level the lift lets go again, so hiss, hum and silence stay down. Set it just over the noise of the source.

params.name: Rise
params.description: How slowly the lift comes in once the sound has gone quiet. Short fills every gap between notes; long waits for a real pause or a tail.

params.name: Fall
params.description: How quickly the lift gets out of the way of a new loud sound. Short leaves every attack untouched; long lets the lift linger into the note.

params.name: Split
params.description: How much the lows, the middle and the highs are judged apart. At nothing the sound rises as one; fully up quiet highs come up even under loud lows.

params.name: Focus
params.description: Which part of the spectrum is lifted most. Left lifts the lows and leaves the highs, right lifts the air and leaves the lows, the middle is even.

params.name: Sides
params.description: How much of the lift goes to the sides alone. At nothing the image stays as it is; fully up only what differs between left and right rises, so a tail opens outward.

params.name: Limit
params.description: The most gain the lift may ever add. Lower it to keep the very quietest sound from being pulled far up; at nothing there is no lift.

params.name: Hear
params.description: All is the sound with its quiet end lifted. Lift only plays just what was added, the tails and breaths alone, for a send or a layer.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the untouched sound and the lifted one. Part way gives a gentler lift with the same timing.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. An upward compressor for sustained sound: stereo-linked RMS and peak detection on the whole sound and on three gently split bands, a floor under which it lets go, a short lookahead so attacks are never lifted; not a model of any unit.
